statement: Lambda's fetched pricing page showed no H200 and no AMD MI355X or MI400 SKU, and offers no spot instances.
why: Which accelerators a large rental provider does not list tells you where alternative silicon has yet to reach the rental channel.

impact.mechanism: Absence of AMD accelerator SKUs at a major GPU cloud indicates alternative merchant-GPU supply has not yet penetrated this rental channel, keeping demand concentrated on the incumbent.

evidence.excerpt: No H200 or MI355X/MI400 SKU was visible in the fetched pricing content.
No spot instances offered -- Lambda states all GPU instances are fixed-rate on-demand, not subject to preemption.

confidence.basis: Direct observation of one vendor's public catalog; absence in a fetched page is weaker than a stated catalog list.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> unknown); sources: BigGo Finance, Lambda (Lambda Labs)
